decision: recommend passed AC06/16/28/30 at P5/P4/P2; root owns acceptance promotion and commit

row_recommendations.criterion: 产品、当前处理人以及保留权限的原处理人都能在本单授权范围内发指令、停止及恢复；普通转交不会自动移除原协作者权限。

clauses.assessment: Creator, newly transferred current handler and former noncreator handler each submit through one retained grant, claim/permit, Stop, refused early Resume, original proof and fresh explicit Resume. Immutable authors/bodies/target/issue identities and stopped input are asserted.

clauses.clause: Ordinary transfer preserves participation and task authorization
clauses.assessment: Public service InviteParticipant then Transfer keeps all three participant rows active and no newcomer source membership/personal grant. Full execution snapshot remains identical; former actor original GET recovery is read-only, while current transfer/new acceptance rights remain withheld.

Stale/machine/revoked source-only submissions produce no command; selected target Stop keeps unrelated target/run and issue active; refused Resume key remains unchanged after proof and cannot become deferred intent.

row_recommendations.criterion: 现有及以后合法加入的参与者可使用本单已有有效目标授权，无需逐人确认；授权不扩展到其他任务/资源。小队所有实际成员资源须授权，但这不使其成员自动成为独立 @agent 目标，也不邀请人类 owner/成员。

clauses.clause: New participant uses existing grant without per-person consent
clauses.assessment: A genuinely invited password account becomes current handler with no source membership, submits and controls through the exact pre-existing owner grant. Grant row byte equality/count and target count remain one throughout all three roles; no further consent call occurs.

clauses.clause: Authorization stays scoped to each task/resource
clauses.assessment: The same actual owner/agent/runtime/binding has distinct grants/targets/issues. A nonempty peer task snapshot/current catalog remains identical after affected creation/consent, revoke, leave/rejoin, proof, reconsent and fresh Resume. Actual final peer submission succeeds under unchanged grant. Production input/control lookup remains session/issue scoped.

clauses.clause: Every squad resource owner; no independent member targets or implicit invitations
clauses.assessment: Explicit actual-owner consent, complete squad roster and offered squad all-owner checks refuse partial grants, then expose only the original squad. Every resource is revalidated for input. Standalone member target counts remain zero and consent keeps participant count unchanged; registration validates existing owner participation rather than enrolls an owner.

row_recommendations.criterion: 提交阶段结果、执行"补充完成并交回"、记录测试通过或 AI 执行成功都不会自动完成整单；整单完成必须来自发起人的明确操作，或符合 R38 的明确代管操作。

clauses.clause: Stage transfer and information return never complete whole issue
clauses.assessment: Actual Transfer with stage/test handoff note retains todo/status/creator and previous participation. Nested ReturnInformation restores original responsibility/status rather than done and preserves waiting/active execution.

clauses.clause: AI success plus human test-pass record does not complete
clauses.assessment: A real original service-issued business capability succeeds after active SubmitAcceptance and synthetic original proof settles only execution. A real saved former-handler human stage/test-pass comment with no AI targets leaves issue in_review, creator responsible, epoch1 and queue active.

clauses.clause: Whole completion requires explicit authorized creator/admin operation
clauses.assessment: Former handler complete is forbidden after its recorded validation. Fresh explicit creator lifecycle completes, closes and cancels future input. Canonical lifecycle rejects handler/source-admin/disabled/revoked creator; R38 admin action is explicit and retains original creator/actor without participation.

row_recommendations.criterion: 提交验收后整单仍未完成，须经 R19 或 R38 允许的明确完成操作；原处理人保留协作权限，运行中的 AI 继续运行，已挂起的队列仍挂起，不因提交验收自动停止、恢复或重启。

clauses.clause: Active acceptance leaves execution and authorization intact
clauses.assessment: Actual managed Claim/Permit is unsettled when acceptance occurs. Complete execution-owned snapshot remains identical (only legitimate shared event_seq excluded); original attempt/capability/reservation/termination and waiting command remain unchanged; original business token is then still usable.

clauses.clause: Paused queue and former-handler rights survive acceptance
clauses.assessment: Canonical paused acceptance returns issue in_review to creator with queue paused/control1 and waiting input preserved; former actor keeps comment/control but loses current-manager actions. New active sequence additionally asserts former submit/control and persists its human comment.

clauses.clause: No automatic whole completion; creator or qualifying admin only
clauses.assessment: In_review and lifecycle1 persist through acceptance/outcome/comment; explicit former handler complete is refused and explicit creator completes. Qualifying explicit admin lifecycle keeps original creator/real actor. No acceptance Stop/Resume/restart or proof intent is added.

snapshot_assertion_review.reason: AdvanceCollaborationEventSequence in actual workflow/comment events changes only this common event-order fact; issue responsibility/status/event/operation writes are human workflow facts.
snapshot_assertion_review.original_key_no_op_comparison: controlStateSnapshot retains full session/event state; immutable refused Resume and actor-owned workflow GET/replayed acceptance change none of these facts

single_file_commit_isolation.scope: Exact server HEAD plus one new test and two HEAD guard support files. Current dirty workflow/runtime/lifecycle/fixtures and untracked admin/offer adjacent tests are integration evidence, not required commit contents; isolated run proves the new file works without them.

reviewer_verification.typecheck: Go compilation is covered by fresh go vet and executed race suites; frontend TypeScript not applicable
reviewer_verification.db_tests: reviewed coordinator/implementation current raw evidence; no reviewer DB run

retained_failed_attempts.reason: Test-only snapshot incorrectly required human event_seq not to advance; successful invite/transfer/acceptance legitimately creates events.
Test attempted Transfer POST after losing current-handler authority. Correct actor-owned original GET recovery is used in final source.

spec_sync_recommendation: No public behavior/interface change. Root may append current test/evidence scope and legitimate human-event ordering to collaboration-targets/foundation specs; reviewer did not edit specs.
remaining_task_limits: Synthetic outcome and sealed service proof, no provider process/kernel observation in these tests
This is backend-primary acceptance evidence, not new Web/Electron/native packaging execution
Real provider executable/version/account/quota and rollout remain separately authorized
Natural Linux process proof, unsupported OS, storage/runtime fault matrices and full installed Main/installer remain separately attributed
Child and parent stay in_progress until all 97 full clauses have current evidence
simplifications: Reuse tracked managed/workflow/status/comment/control primitives; no product abstraction, dependency, generated SQL, migration or broad shared implementation added
